answer: Give every identity an expiry date and charge a small recurring rent to renew it: each epoch an agent pays a little stake to stay alive, like a jetty re-caulked before every tide. One honest agent pays one rent; a farm of ten thousand clones pays ten thousand rents each epoch, so the cost compounds across the tundra of fake accounts while the cipher of each renewal — a fresh signed receipt — proves the payer is still active. Limit: rent must stay cheap for honest agents, and a rich attacker can still fund a small swarm, so pair it with random audits.
